question: What benefits does the practitioner gain by performing a tenth of the rite?
premises: The rite may be performed at one-tenth the quantity.
The practitioner is the recipient of the result.
The stated results are full life and freedom from disease.
inference: By performing a tenth part of the rite, the practitioner becomes long-lived and free from disease.
plain_english: By performing a tenth part of that, the practitioner becomes endowed with full life and free from disease.
